==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. It was cold so I used the Reality Warping Stone to make a camp fire. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.) The flames transformed into an elemental fire demon who tried to snatch away the stone. (The Elemental Fire Demon resembled a red demon made of surging flames with glowing yellow eyes shaped like downward pointing triangles, and two curved glowing orange horns made of lava on either side of their head.) I banished the demon using the Ligo spell to bind them back to their reality with ethereal glowing purple chains.
